meaning.en: the process of dealing with or controlling things or people
a person responsible for controlling or administering an organization
to be in charge of; to succeed in doing something difficult

meaning.vi: có thể quản lý, có thể giải quyết
meaning.en: able to be managed or dealt with
difficult or impossible to manage

notes.vi: Liên quan đến các chủ đề về kinh doanh, công việc và giải quyết vấn đề.
notes.en: Related to topics of business, work, and problem-solving.

meaning.en: an act of changing physical location; a group of people working together for a cause
to go in a specified direction or manner
producing strong emotions, especially sadness or sympathy

notes.vi: Lưu ý nghĩa bóng của 'moving' (cảm động) và 'movement' (phong trào).
notes.en: Note the figurative meanings of 'moving' (touching) and 'movement' (a campaign).

meaning.en: a large body of people united by common descent, history, culture, or language
the status of belonging to a particular nation
to transfer from private to state ownership or control
relating to a nation
existing or occurring between two or more nations
on a national scale
in a way that involves more than one country

notes.vi: Các từ 'national' và 'international' rất quan trọng trong nhiều chủ đề.
notes.en: The words 'national' and 'international' are very important in many topics.

meaning.vi: sự vận hành; ca phẫu thuật
meaning.en: the action of functioning or the fact of being active; an act of surgery
a person who operates equipment or a machine
to control the functioning of; to perform surgery
in or ready for use

notes.vi: Một họ từ có nhiều nghĩa trong cả lĩnh vực kỹ thuật và y tế.
notes.en: A word family with meanings in both technical and medical fields.

meaning.en: an organized group of people with a particular purpose
a person who arranges an event or activity
to arrange systematically; to coordinate
arranged in a systematic way
not properly planned and controlled

notes.vi: Kỹ năng 'organize' là một phẩm chất cá nhân quan trọng.
notes.en: The skill to 'organize' is an important personal quality.

meaning.en: the condition, state, or quality of being free from all flaws

meaning.vi: sự không hoàn hảo, khuyết điểm
meaning.en: a fault, blemish, or undesirable feature
to make something completely free from faults
having all the required or desirable elements
not perfect; faulty or incomplete
in a manner that could not be better

notes.vi: Hữu ích khi đánh giá một sự vật, hiện tượng.
notes.en: Useful when evaluating an object or phenomenon.

meaning.en: the action of officially allowing someone to do something
to officially allow someone to do something
permitted; allowed

notes.vi: Một cách nói trang trọng hơn của 'allow'. 'Permission' là danh từ không đếm được.
notes.en: A more formal way of saying 'allow'. 'Permission' is an uncountable noun.

meaning.en: a human being
the combination of characteristics that form an individual's distinctive character
to design or produce something to meet someone's individual requirements
belonging to or affecting a particular person

meaning.vi: khách quan, không liên quan đến cá nhân
meaning.en: not influenced by, showing, or involving personal feelings
used to emphasize that you are giving your own opinion

notes.vi: 'Personally' là một cụm từ tốt để bắt đầu đưa ra quan điểm của bạn.
notes.en: 'Personally' is a good phrase to introduce your own opinion.
